scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Let's book a canoe. Enter your email and we'll send you a code.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your order opens empty, so add a person first.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Open a collection. Canoes, kayaks and paddle boards each have their own.

scenes.label: pick-the-dates
scenes.line: Pick the day you collect the boat, then the day you bring it back. It is held for the whole window.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Agree to the terms and save.

scenes.label: checkout
scenes.line: Enter your card details to finish the booking.

scenes.label: order-complete
scenes.line: That is your order placed. Your invoice is ready and the canoe will be waiting.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: Your booking sits in your order history, ready for the next trip.
